sharedRules.name: Adamantine Will
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this special rule is targeted for an attack by a weapon with the Psychic Weapon special rule or by a Psychic Power. The attack from the Psychic Weapon or Psychic Power is resolved with -1 to all hit rolls and -1 to all wound rolls from that weapon.

sharedRules.name: Assault Vehicle
sharedRules.description:
Models Embarked in a transport with this special rule
are subject to the following:
● Embarked models can shoot and Fight in the shooting Phase and Combat Phase while embarked as normal.
● All measurement and line of sight is measured from the Vehicles hull.
● Units embarked can only ever make 1 attack in the combat phase.
● Unless the embarked unit disembarks during the turn, the embarked unit is considered to have made the same type of movement as the transport for the purposes of determining modifiers and eligibility to shoot.
● When a transport is slain, destroyed, wrecked or explodes with this special rule. Models that disembark are slain on a roll of a 1 or a 2 instead of a 1.
● If a Transport with this special rule is Pinned, the embarked models count as being Pinned as well.

sharedRules.name: Bulky (x)
sharedRules.description: Each model in a unit with this special rule counts as a number of models equal to the value of X for transport capacity in Transports.

sharedRules.name: Battle Smith (x)
sharedRules.description: In the Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule may forfeit its Shooting Attack to attempt perform a Machine Rite. The Machine Rites available to a unit are listed in their relevant Codex. The value of (x) is the number of Machine Rites a unit may attempt to perform each phase. To perform a Machine Rite, the unit performing it must make a Leadership Test. If the roll is equal to or lower than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is passed, and the Machine Rite is successfully performed. If the roll is greater than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is failed, and Rite is not performed. If a unit with more than 1 model with this special rule wishes to perform a Rite, only 1 model in the unit must forfeit its Shooting Attack. A unit with the Firing Protocols (x) special rule, can forfeit one of its Shooting Attacks to perform any number of Machine Rites equal to the value of Battle Smith (x). A unit cannot perform the same Rite more than once per Phase unless otherwise stated.

sharedRules.name: Battle Hardened
sharedRules.description: A model with this special rule treats its Toughness (T) characteristic as being 1 higher for the purposes of determining Instant Death. This does not affect standard to wound rolls.

sharedRules.name: Character
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule may be attached to another unit of the same type which consists of 2 or more models during deployment. The unit with this special rule cannot leave its unit and join another unit unless all models from the previously attached unit have been slain.


A unit with this special rule does not confer any special rules or affects they have unless specifically stated. A unit with this special rule is treated as being a part of its attached unit for all purposes including movement, targeting, reactions and wounds allocation.


Vehicle, Knight, Titan, Aircraft or Fortification type units with this special rule cannot join units.


A unit which includes an attached unit with this special rule that has an alternative deployment option (Outflank, Deep Strike, etc) may only use that option if both units have the alternative deployment option.


Only 1 unit with this special rule may attached to a unit without this special rule at any given time.


To join a new unit, the Character must end its movement phase within coherency of the new unit they wish to attach to.


If a Character or its attached unit Set to perform a Reaction, both units are counted as Set to perform a Reaction. Both units do not need to be able to perform the same Reaction.

sharedRules.name: Counter Attack
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this special rule is charged, it gains +1 to its Attacks (A) characteristic until the end of the following Combat Phase.

sharedRules.name: Deep Strike
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule can be placed off the board in reserves during deployment (see 3.1). At the start of your movement phase, starting in the second battle round, place the unit placed in reserves with this special rule on the battlefield anywhere more than 3” away from any enemy models and roll a D6.


1-2: Mishap!: The unit is removed from play and the battlefield and placed back into reserve instead of being deployed.


3-4: Minimal Deviation: The opponent scatters the unit within 5" of where it was placed on the battlefield.


5-6: Perfect landing: The unit arrives where its placed, on target and does not scatter.

sharedRules.name: Crusader
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule, rolls an extra D6 when performing a Sweeping Advance roll.

sharedRules.name: Fade & Fire
sharedRules.description: A model with this special rule may perform a Retreat move in the Movement Phase and still Shoot in the Shooting Phase at full Ballistic Skill (BS).

sharedRules.name: Deny the Witch
sharedRules.description: Enemy Psyker units within 24” and Line of sight of a model from a unit with this special rule suffer -1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic when attempting to cast a Psychic power.

sharedRules.name: Feel no Pain
sharedRules.description:
When a model in a unit with the Feel no Pain Special rule is allocated a wound, you may roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or higher then (X) next to the Special rules name, the wound is ignored (see 10.3)
E.g: For Feel no Pain (5+), a roll of 5 or higher is required to ignore the wound when allocating it.

sharedRules.name: Fear (x)
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a model from a unit with this special rule suffer a negative modifier equal to the value of (x) to their Leadership (LD) Characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Fleet
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule can Advance and still declare a Charge in the Charge Phase. (see 6.3).

sharedRules.name: Fly
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule ignores other models and terrain features when you trace the path of its move across the battlefield (it flies over them). In addition, when a model in a unit with this special rule starts or finishes a move on a terrain feature, instead of tracing its move across the battlefield, you can trace it through the air.


A flying model cannot finish its move on top of another model or finish any Normal Move, Advance, or Retreat within 3” of any enemy models. Models with Fly are not subject to Dangerous or Difficult Terrain rules when passing through such terrain but will still take Dangerous Terrain Tests (per 7.3.5) if they end their move on top of such terrain unless they are an Aircraft.


Units with the Fly special rule may Retreat and still shoot in the shooting phase at their full Ballistic Skill (BS). Units with this special rule may Charge Aircraft type units,

sharedRules.name: Expendable
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule does not count as contesting an objective if an enemy model is also within 6” of the objective marker. A unit with this special rule never counts for Victory Points when slain.

sharedRules.name: Fire Points (x)
sharedRules.description: A number of Infantry type models embarked on a unit with this special rule may make Shooting Attacks in the Shooting Phase equal to value of X. The embarked units draw line of sight from the hull of the unit with this special rule and count as being Stationary.

sharedRules.name: Firing Protocols (x)
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule may attack in the shooting phase with a number of different weapons equal to the value of (x). Each weapon may target a different unit.

sharedRules.name: Frenzy
sharedRules.description: If a unit with this special rule has had any wounds allocated to it that are not ignored or models from the unit have been slain, then for the rest of the game, it gains +1 Attacks (A) Characteristic but must always attempt to charge if it is within 12” of an enemy unit and did not Advance or Retreat in the previous Movement phase (see 12.0).

sharedRules.name: Furious Charge (x)
sharedRules.description: A unit with the Furious Charge special rule gains +1 to its Strength (S) Characteristic in the Combat Phase if it successfully charged in the previous Charge Phase.

sharedRules.name: Hammer of Wrath (x)
sharedRules.description:
At Initiative step 10 during the Fight sequence (see 13.1), every model in the unit in melee range may makes a number of attacks equal to the value of X at  Strength User attack with AP6 so long as the unit completed a charge that turn. The models then proceed to pile in and attack normally at their regular
Initiative (I) characteristics or modified Initiative (I) characteristics.


If the unit with this special rule is a Vehicle, Walker, Monster, or Automata with a Wound (W) characteristic of 4 or greater, the attack has AP2. Hammer of Wrath attacks are only ever made in the first round of a combat. These attacks hit automatically.

sharedRules.name: Hatred (x)
sharedRules.description: A model from a unit with this special rule can re-roll wound rolls of 1 against enemy units. Where the (x) following the special rule has a unit type (see 18.0) or Keyword, the unit can only re-roll wound rolls of 1 against units with that specific type or Keyword. If no type or keyword is indicated by an (x), the unit re-rolls all wound rolls of 1 regardless of type or keyword of the target enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Hit & Run
sharedRules.description: At initiative 0 before step 8 of the Fight Sequence (see 13.1), a unit with this rule can opt to hit and run. The unit must take an Initiative test. Roll a D6. If it's lower than or equal to the unit's Initiative (I) characteristic, the test is passed the unit may immediately make a normal move as if it were the movement phase (see 6.1) and the attack sequence ends. If it fails, proceed to step 8 of the Fight Sequence (see 13.1).

sharedRules.name: Hover
sharedRules.description: An Aircraft with this Special rule must declare at the start of its movement phase if it will Hover or Fly. If the unit Hovers, it gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic and its Movement (M) characteristic becomes 12”. Hovering Aircraft units can be charged by units without the Fly special rule, measuring distances to the Aircraft’s base. An Aircraft unit that is Hovering does not automatically explode when immobilised. A unit Hovering is no longer hit on 6+ by enemy shooting attacks. An Aircraft is treated as a Vehicle type while the unit is Hovering.

sharedRules.name: Infiltrate
sharedRules.description: At the end of the deployment step after deployment but before the first turn begins, units with this special rule may be placed anywhere on the board, instead of in your deployment zone but may not be placed within the enemy deployment zone. If both players have units that can infiltrate, players take turns alternating between deploying infiltrating units, starting with the player that is the Attacker in the Scenario. Infiltrating units cannot deploy within 6” of another Infiltrating unit.

sharedRules.name: Move through Cover
sharedRules.description: Models in a unit with this special rule ignore the effects of Difficult terrain and Dangerous Terrain.

sharedRules.name: Last Stand
sharedRules.description: Models in a unit with this special rule may still fight in the Combat phase even if they would be slain before they are eligible to fight. If a model with this special rule is slain before it gets to fight, it may fight at Initiative 1. Do not remove the slain model until after it has fought.

sharedRules.name: Monster Hunter
sharedRules.description: Models in a unit with this special rule may re-roll wound rolls against units with the Monster type.

sharedRules.name: Outflank
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule can be placed off the board in reserves during deployment (see 3.1). At the start of your movement phase, starting in the second battle round, you can roll a D6 for each unit in reserves. On a roll of a 3+, you can place a unit with this special rule on the board anywhere wholly within a number of inches equal to its Movement (M) characteristic of any board edge and more than 6” away from any enemy models. This counts as a Normal Move. The unit may not make any additional moves the turn it arrives but may declare charges in the charge phase.

sharedRules.name: Priest (x)
sharedRules.description: In the Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule may to attempt perform a Prayer. The Prayer available to a unit are listed in their relevant Codex. The value of (x) is the number of Prayer a unit may attempt to perform each phase. To perform a Prayer, the unit performing it must make a Leadership Test. If the roll is equal to or lower than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is passed, and the Prayer is successfully performed. If the roll is greater than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is failed, and Prayer is not performed. If a unit with more than 1 model with this special rule wishes to perform a Prayer, only 1 model in the unit performs the Prayer. A unit cannot chant the same prayer more than once per Phase unless otherwise stated.

sharedRules.name: Preferred enemy (x)
sharedRules.description: A model from a unit with this special rule can re-roll hit rolls of 1 against enemy units. Where the (x) following the special rule has a unit type (see 18.0) or Keyword, the unit can only re-roll hit of 1 against units with that specific type or Keyword. If no type or keyword is indicated by an (x), the unit re-rolls all hit rolls of 1 regardless of type or keyword of the target enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Rage
sharedRules.description: At the start of the Combat Phase, a unit with this special rule can choose to increase every model in the unit's Attack (A) characteristic by 1 but all models in the unit suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the end of the Phase.

sharedRules.name: Regeneration
sharedRules.description: At the start of your movement phase, roll 1D6. On a roll of a 5+, one model in the unit heals 1 wound (10.4).

sharedRules.name: Relentless
sharedRules.description: Models in a unit with this special rule can move and fire Heavy Weapons at their full Ballistic Skill (BS) (see 9.4.1). In addition, units with this special rule may declare a charge move in the Charge Phase, even if they made a shooting attack with a Heavy or Rapid Fire weapon.

sharedRules.name: Scout
sharedRules.description: A Unit with this special rule can, after deployment but before the first battle round begins, make a normal move as if it were the movement phase (see 6.1). A unit that used the Infiltrate special rule to deploy may not make a Scout move.

sharedRules.name: Psyker (x)
sharedRules.description:
In the Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule may to attempt perform a Prayer. The Prayer available to a unit are listed in their relevant Codex. The value of (x) is the number of Prayer a unit may attempt to perform each phase. To perform a Prayer, the unit performing it must make a Leadership Test. If the roll is equal to or lower than the units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is passed, and the Prayer is successfully performed. If the roll is greater than the
units Leadership (LD) characteristic, the test is failed, and Prayer is not performed. If a unit with more than 1 model with this special rule wishes to perform a Prayer, only 1 model in the unit performs the Prayer. A unit cannot chant the same prayer more than once per Phase unless otherwise stated.

sharedRules.name: Siege Attackers
sharedRules.description: The unit with this special rule can re-roll all rolls to penetrate against units with the Fortification type (see 9.5.6).

sharedRules.name: Skilled Rider
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule always counts as having a Light Cover save. If the unit with this special rule advanced during their previous movement phase, they have a Heavy Cover save.

sharedRules.name: Slow and purposeful
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule may not make Reactions except for setting to Smoke (see 12.2) and may not Advance (see 6.3) or Sweeping Advance (see 13.1).

sharedRules.name: Sprint (x)
sharedRules.description: A unit with the Sprint Special rule adds the value of (x) to all Advance moves (see 6.3) and Charge moves they make (see 12.1).

sharedRules.name: Stubborn
sharedRules.description: A Unit that has this special rule never suffers any negative modifiers to their Leadership (LD) Characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Indomitable Spirit (x+)
sharedRules.description: Models with this special rule may make an Invulnerable save equal to x against Psychic weapons.

sharedRules.name: Sudden Strike
sharedRules.description: A unit with the Sudden Strike special rule adds 1 to its Initiative (I) characteristic in the combat phase after it has completed a charge move (see 12.1). If the character has Initiative 1 from an Unwieldy weapon in the Combat Phase, their Initiative is still increased by the value of 1 (Initiative 1 becomes Initiative 2).

sharedRules.name: Night Vision
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule ignores the Night Fighting rules in Battle plans where it is active.

sharedRules.name: Super Heavy (x)
sharedRules.description:
A Vehicle/Knight/Titan/Aircraft with the Super Heavy (X) special rule gains the following benefits:
● The Vehicle/Aircraft has a number of Structure points equal to the value of X. Each time the Vehicle/Aircraft suffers a Critical result on the Vehicle damage chart that would cause it to be wrecked or explode, it instead loses 1 Structure Point. If the Vehicle/Aircraft has no more Structure points when it suffers a Critical damage result on the Vehicle damage chart, the Critical result is resolved as normal instead.
● When a Vehicle/Aircraft with this special rule would suffer a Critical result on the Vehicle Damage chart that would cause it to explode, it instead explodes 10”, hitting all models within range with 1 Strength 6, AP4 hit.
● When a Walker with this special rule would be reduced to 0 wounds, it explodes 10”, hitting all models within range with 1 Strength 6, AP4 hit.
● A model with this special rule may move and still fire weapons with the Ordnance Special rule.
● When a model with this special rule suffers an Immobilized result on the Vehicle Damage Chart, it instead halves its Movement (M) characteristic. This may be repaired by a unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule in place of an Immobilized result

sharedRules.name: Tank Hunters
sharedRules.description: The unit with this special rule can roll 2D6 on the Vehicle damage chart when resolving penetrating hits and pick which result will be applied (see 10.1).

sharedRules.name: Zealot
sharedRules.description: A unit with the Zealot special rule adds 1 to its Attacks (A) Characteristic in the combat phase after it has completed a charge move (see 12.1)

sharedRules.name: Skirmisher
sharedRules.description: A unit with the Skirmisher special rule has a 3” horizontal coherency and 9” vertical coherency. In addition, the unit gains +1 to its Cover Saves (Max of 4+) when receiving the benefits of Cover.

sharedRules.name: Support Squad
sharedRules.comment: todo: don't count towards min in Force Org
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule may not be fielded as a compulsory choice in your army Force Organization Chart.

sharedRules.name: Arcing (x)
sharedRules.description: Each to hit roll inflicts 2 hits with this weapon instead of 1 if the to Hit roll was equal to or greater than the value of (x). Resolve each hit separately.

sharedRules.name: Bane (x)
sharedRules.description:
A unit hit by a weapon with this special rule that has the (x) keyword or unit type may not make Invulnerable saves against wounds caused by a weapon with this special rule. If no type or keyword is indicated by an
(x), the unit ignores all Invulnerable saves with the weapon regardless of type or keyword of the target enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Blast (x)
sharedRules.description:
Instead of rolling to hit normally with a weapon with this trait during step 1 of the shooting attack sequence (see 9.5), place the centre of a Blast Marker anywhere on the battlefield within the weapon’s range and line of sight, while touching at least one model from the target unit, then make the hit roll.


If a hit is scored, models within 2" (for Blast (Small)) or 3” (for Blast (Large)) of the markers take one hit each, rolling for wounds and saves as normal.


If a miss was scored, the opposing player may move the marker/change the target point D6" (for Blast (Small) or D6+2” (for Blast (Large)) in any direction of their choosing. The centre of the marker may not be scattered or placed off the board. After moving the marker, all models within 2" (for Blast (Small)) or 3” (for Blast (Large)), take one hit each from the weapon, rolling for wounds and saves as normal.


Measurements for determining what is hit are to a model's base unless it doesn’t have one.


For determining Cover and AV facings, draw line of sight from the attackers direction and not the blast marker.


The Blast Special rule targets a unit but cannot be fired if the unit making the attack would be subject to Snap Shots as a result of a movement action or other effect. A unit which is required to make snap shots may not fire a weapon with the Blast special rule under any circumstances.

sharedRules.name: Bombing Run
sharedRules.description:
In the shooting phase, this weapon can be used to make an attack against one enemy unit that the equipped model passed over in the previous
movement phase (see 7.4.1). Weapons with this special rule always hit a Vehicle, Knight or Titans Rear Armor. This weapon cannot target or resolve hits against units with the Fly special rule.

sharedRules.name: Barrage (x)
sharedRules.description: When determining the number of models hit by a Blast or Large Blast weapon, a weapon with this special rule scores an additional number of hits equal to the value of X. Distribute these additional hits to units within range of the blast marker as evenly as possible rounding up.

sharedRules.name: Blind
sharedRules.description:
A unit hit by a weapon with this special rule may not make Reactions. i.e. Overwatch, Counter Charge, etc. In addition, when a weapon with this special rule resolves a hit against an enemy unit, the target unit hit by this weapon's attack halves its Ballistic Skill (BS) & Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the end of the following combat phase (see 13.1). This does not affect
Vehicle, Fortification, Aircraft, Knight or Titan type units.

sharedRules.name: Piercing
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule is treated as being Strength x2 if the equipped model successfully completed a Charge in the previous Charge Phase.

sharedRules.name: Concussive
sharedRules.description: When a weapon with this special rule resolves a hit against an enemy unit, the target unit hit by this weapon's attack halves its Initiative (I) characteristic until the end of the following combat phase (see 13.1). This does not affect Vehicle, Walker, Aircraft, Knight, Fortification or Titan type units.

sharedRules.name: Crushing (x)
sharedRules.description: A weapon with the Crushing special rule inflicts 2 wounds instead of 1 if the to Wound roll was equal to or greater than the roll represented by (x). Make a save roll for each wound inflicted separately.

sharedRules.name: Cumbersome
sharedRules.description:
A melee weapon with this rule can only ever make a single attack in the combat phase, regardless of its Attacks (A) characteristics or from extra close
combat weapons. You may claim the bonus for Charging.

sharedRules.name: Force
sharedRules.description: At the Beginning of Combat, a model equipped with a weapon that has this special rule may make a Psychic Test per Casting a Psychic Power (see 17.1). If the Psychic test is successful, all wounds inflicted by the weapon with this special rule count as Instant Death Wounds until the end of the Combat Phase.

sharedRules.name: Gets Hot!
sharedRules.description:
When a weapon with the Gets Hot special rule rolls a 1 to hit, the model firing the model takes 1 automatic wound. They may take an armour save as normal
against that wound (see 9.5). If a Vehicle suffers Gets Hot! the weapon with this special rule is destroyed as if the vehicle suffered the effects of a Weapon Destroyed Result on the Vehicle Damage Chart.

sharedRules.name: Haywire (x)
sharedRules.description:
A weapon with this special rule always scores a wound or penetrating hit against Vehicles, Automata, Walkers, Knight, Aircraft, Battlesuit, Drones on a roll of X as represented next to the rule.


All other unit types use the weapons base strength instead.


If when comparing the weapons Strength characteristic against the targets Toughness or Armour Value characteristic, the wound roll required is lower than the Haywire roll indicated in the brackets or vice-versa, use the lowest required to Wound or Penetrate roll for determining if the weapon inflicts a wound or Penetrating Hit on the target. Haywire (X) is not considered a triggered effect (see 1.7.4)

sharedRules.name: Ignores Cover
sharedRules.description: Cover saves cannot be taken against a weapon with this special rule (see 9.5.2).

sharedRules.name: Murderous Strike (x)
sharedRules.description: If a weapon with this special rule rolls a wound roll equal to or greater than the value of X, if that wound is not saved or mitigated, it is treated as an Instant Death Wound. Primarch, Monster, & Walker type units suffer D3 wounds instead.

sharedRules.name: Indirect Fire
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this trait may opt to fire indirectly. The weapon does not need Line of Sight to targets when picking targets for attacks in the shooting phase (see 9.2). However, the model or unit suffers -1 modifier to hit rolls against targets it cannot see. For resolving casualties and allocating wounds, Indirect Fire weapons ignore the requirements on visibility when allocating wounds (see 9.1). Indirect Fire weapons may fire beyond Night Fighting Range. Indirect Fire weapons use the final placement of the target marker to determine the AV facing (Side AV if the hit is direct), are hit and what Cover Saves a model might get (the final marker determines Line of Sight for Cover Saves).

sharedRules.name: Lance
sharedRules.description: Weapons with this special rule count a Vehicle, Titan, Aircraft, or Knight type units Armor Value that is higher than 12 as 12.

sharedRules.name: Ammo (x)
sharedRules.description: A Weapon with this special rule can only be used a number of times in a game equal to X.

sharedRules.name: Master-Crafted
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule may re-roll 1 hit roll per phase. Spray weapons with this special rule may re-roll 1 wound roll per phase instead.

sharedRules.name: Melta
sharedRules.description: A weapon with the Melta special rule has +2 to its Strength characteristic when within half range or melee (see 9.5.6).

sharedRules.name: Macro
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule has +2 to the roll when rolling on the Vehicle damage chart or Titan Damage chart. Macro weapons ignore the Super Heavy special rule and any Super Heavy Structure points a target has for determining of they would be destroyed from an attack.

sharedRules.name: Ordnance
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with a weapon that has the Ordnance special rule must remain stationary to Shoot in the Shooting Phase. A model that fires an Ordnance Weapon cannot charge in the Charge Phase. Ordnance weapons may not be fired a Snapshot, on Overwatch or into engaged models within 3”.

sharedRules.name: Psychic Weapon
sharedRules.description: This weapon counts as a Psychic Power for any rules that would affect Psychic Powers. To make a Shooting Attack with a weapon that has this special rule must pass a Psychic Test as if they were casting a Psychic Power (see Psyker (x) special rule). If the test is failed, the equipped model may not make an attack with this weapon that phase. This counts towards the number of Psychic Powers a Psyker may cast each Shooting Phase. Note that the Psychic Test for casting a Psychic Weapon can result in a Peril of the Warp per normal.

sharedRules.name: Precision Hits
sharedRules.description: When allocating attacks, if the attacking model causes a wound with a weapon that has this special rule, the player controlling the attacking unit may dictate which models in the target unit must have the wounds allocated to them in (see 10.1).

sharedRules.name: Poison (x)
sharedRules.description:
A weapon with this special rule always wounds on a roll of X as represented next to the rule. Poison weapons use their normal Strength against Vehicles, Aircraft, Drones, Knights, Titans, Automata & Walkers however.


If when comparing the weapons Strength characteristic against the targets Toughness or Armour Value characteristic, the wound roll required is lower than the Poison roll indicated in the brackets or vice-versa, use the lowest required to Wound or Penetrate roll for determining if the weapon inflicts a wound on the target. Poison (X) is not considered a triggered effect (see 1.7.4)

sharedRules.name: Pinning
sharedRules.description:
A unit that is hit by a weapon with this special rule must make a Pinning test in step 5 of the shooting attack sequence in addition to a panic test:


To make the Pinning test, Roll 2D6. If the roll is equal to or lower than the target units Leadership Characteristic, the test is passed and the attack sequence ends. If the test is failed, place a Pinned marker on the unit. A pinned unit:
● halves its Movement (M) characteristic.
● has -1 to hit rolls with all Shooting attacks.
● may not make Reactions in the Charge phase and any currently set reactions are cancelled.


Remove the Pinned Marker from a unit at the end of units controller’s next turn. Regardless of the number of tests failed, a unit can only ever have 1 Pinned marker. A unit only ever makes 1 Pinning test per unit shooting attack in step 5 of the attack sequence. (Example: A unit with 5 Heavy Bolters targets a Guardsman squad. The Guard make 1 Pinning test after all Heavy Bolter shots have been resolved. In the same phase, the next unit targets the same Guardsman squad with 2 pinning weapons. After all shooing attacks are resolved, the guard squad makes 1 Pinning test.)

sharedRules.name: Rending (x)
sharedRules.description:
When a weapon with this special rule rolls an unmodified roll equal to (x) to wound, that wound is resolved at AP2 instead of its normal AP value (see 9.5.1).


If rolling to Penetrate against an Armour Value, the weapons attack against the target is resolved with +1 to the weapons Strength characteristic for determining if the weapon caused a Penetrating hit on a roll of (x).

sharedRules.name: Reach
sharedRules.description: A model with this weapon has a melee range of 2” instead of 1”.

sharedRules.name: Shred
sharedRules.description: A weapon with Shred can re-roll all wound rolls (see 9.5).

sharedRules.name: Specialist Weapon
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with a weapon with this special rule does not gain the extra +1 attack benefit of equipped with more than 1 melee weapon unless all melee weapons they are equipped with have this special rule.

sharedRules.name: Spray
sharedRules.description: Instead of rolling to hit normally with a weapon with this trait during step 1 of the shooting attack sequence (see 9.5), a weapon with this special rule chooses the unit being targeted by the Spray weapon. The weapon hits once for each model in the unit that is within range of the spray weapon up to a max of 5 automatic hits per weapon. Roll to wound and Saves as normal. Spray weapons ignore cover saves. When performing Overwatch, a Spray weapon automatically inflicts its max 5 number of hits instead of measuring number of targets instead. Spray weapons can never target Aircraft. Spray weapons cannot make Snap Shots.

sharedRules.name: Swift Strike
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule always strikes at initiative step 6 in the Fight Sequence unless the equipped model's Initiative (I) characteristic is higher (see 13.1).

sharedRules.name: Skyfire
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule can fire at Aircraft with its full Ballistic Skill (see 9.2.4). A unit that set to Overwatch may fire this weapon at Aircraft units with its full range instead of 12”. A weapon with the Blast or Spray special rule loses this special rule if they gain the Skyfire special rule. A Skyfire weapon suffers -1 to its hit rolls against units without the Fly special rule.

sharedRules.name: Sunder
sharedRules.description: A Weapon with the Sunder special rule re-rolls Penetration rolls.

sharedRules.name: Sweeping (x)
sharedRules.description: A model attacking with a weapon with this special rule makes an additional number of attacks equal to the value of (x) with this weapon if the target unit has 3 or more models in the target unit.

sharedRules.name: Two-Handed
sharedRules.description: A model attacking with a weapon with this special rule does not count towards or gain the benefit of being equipped with Multiple Melee weapons or Pistols.

sharedRules.name: Linked
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule may re-roll all hit rolls. A Linked weapon with the Spray special rule can score a max 10 hits instead 5.

sharedRules.name: Unwieldy
sharedRules.description: A model’s Initiative (I) characteristic is reduced to 1 when declaring that it will make attacks with a weapon with this special rule at the start of the Fight Sequence (see 13.1).

sharedRules.name: Deflagrate
sharedRules.description: After the attacks of this weapon have been resolved, count the number of unsaved wounds caused on the target. Immediately resolve a number of automatic hits against the target unit equal to that number. These hits use the Strength and AP of the weapon with this special rule. These special hits do not themselves inflict any additional hits, nor benefit from any other special rules possessed by the attacking model or the weapon.

sharedRules.name: Variable
sharedRules.description: When firing this weapon, you must select which mode you will use for that attack.

sharedRules.name: Parry
sharedRules.description: If a model or unit that includes models equipped with a weapon with this special rule is attacked in the Combat Phase, the equipped unit counts its Weapon Skill (WS) or majority Weapon Skill (WS) as 1 Higher for the purposes of determining the required to hit roll against the equipped model or its unit.

sharedRules.name: Combi
sharedRules.description: A model may fire both profiles of a weapon with this special rule even if they do not have the Firing Protocols (x) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Conversion
sharedRules.description: If the target of this weapon is not within half of the weapons range when making an attack, the weapon gains +2 to its Strength characteristic.
